title: Budget-constrained neighbourhood environmental renewal
goal: Produce and verify a spatial intervention plan that preserves development capacity while reducing heat and traffic-source pollutant exposure across uncertain weather, without shifting unacceptable harm to another subarea.
design_motivation: The previous 182-choice experiment found the development optimum in six calls but failed on held-out weather. More options alone do not test planning competence.

proposed_decisions.name: group_height_changes
proposed_decisions.description: Height redistribution across up to eight connected footprint groups selected before evaluation. Connected raster groups are not verified individual buildings.
proposed_decisions.implementation: requires geometry adapter beyond the existing four-sector ClimateProblem

proposed_decisions.name: surface_materials
proposed_decisions.description: Spatial ground-albedo interventions with an explicit area-based synthetic cost.
proposed_decisions.implementation: existing numerical forcing available; finer spatial action mapping needed

proposed_decisions.name: traffic_source_mitigation
proposed_decisions.description: Hypothetical reductions of source intensity in recorded traffic sectors, with a separately stated service/cost tradeoff.
proposed_decisions.implementation: existing normalized source arrays and conservative tracer available; not a traffic rerouting model

constraints: Preserve building-volume proxy within a declared range
Keep fixed receptor support across plans
Constrain local harm as well as domain averages
Charge all numerical queries, including repeated or invalid attempts
Do not count an untested scenario as passed
agent_workflow: Choose which physical process and scenario to evaluate
Diagnose which intervention causes a failed constraint
Repair and re-evaluate under remaining budget
Submit a plan with tested coverage and explicitly unresolved risks

evaluation_design.queryable_scenarios: Predeclare a pool of controlled weather/source conditions; agent chooses queries.
evaluation_design.final_scenarios: Separately freeze conditions not exposed to the agent; score only after all methods submit.
evaluation_design.budgets: Count plan-scenario solver calls and model tokens separately; exact caps not yet frozen.
controls: Same-budget conventional optimization with scenario validation
success_metrics: Pareto quality or predeclared objective tradeoff
evaluation_design.note: This is a task design, not a completed implementation or a new result. Acceptance thresholds and scenario splits must be fixed before formal runs.

missing_for_real_planning: Verified building/parcel identities and editable semantics
Grid/physics validation for the intended exposure layer
pending_scope_preference: Task breadth, agent workflow, or per-building geometry freedom; clarification requested in chat.
scope: Proposed controlled computational benchmark using existing tools. No new libraries installed, no new model run started, no real-world planning approval implied.
